title: [4.6] After migrating from 4.5 to 4.6 - ERROR: Bug: Dictionary::operator[] used when there was no value
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.6.stable.official [89cea1439]
- Not reproducible in v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1]
- Not reproducible in an empty project in v4.6

### System information

Windows 10 - Godot 4.6 - Vulkan 1.4.325 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti SUPER

### Project information
- 3D Project 
- Using Forward Plus
- 14k lines across 176 .tscn files.
- 27k lines of gdscript code in 280 files
- Using externally created 3d models, imported via glb files (maybe relevant due to the linked issue)
- Using different addons, but it happens also when removing all addons completely from the project

### Issue description

After migrating my project from 4.5.1 to 4.6 this morning, i get these logs in the output every time i load the project:

Godot Engine v4.6.stable.official (c) 2007-present Juan Linietsky, Ariel Manzur & Godot Contributors.

### Additional information
Maybe noteworthy:
- My game doesnt start anymore
- All shader code was deleted from some of my shader files (gonna file another bug for that)

### Steps to reproduce

Unfortunatelly i cant provide repro steps, because my project is very big already and i cannot say where it comes from.
